title: 2023 Panini Prizm Pandora Prizm #351 Derius Davis Los Angeles Chargers Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2023 Panini Prizm trading card features Derius Davis, player for the Los Angeles Chargers in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a standard size and part of the base set, with the added feature of being a rookie card. The card is perfect for fans and collectors of NFL and football memorabilia, and would make a great addition to any sports trading card collection. The card is not autographed, but still holds significant value due to its rarity and the popularity of the player and team.
